passages.title: East Wing Laboratory Handover — E-mail and Work Schedule
passages.body:
DOCUMENT 1 — PROJECT E-MAIL
From: Laura Kim, Facilities Integration
To: Laboratory and IT Supervisors
Date: Monday, October 12
Subject: East Wing acceptance and handover dates

The network monitors can be installed on Tuesday as planned, and the IT team may run connectivity diagnostics immediately afterward. However, the replacement temperature sensor will not reach our site until Wednesday afternoon. The calibration certificate cannot be issued until the new sensor has been installed and checked by the external technician.

For that reason, the laboratory's final operational tests must remain on Thursday. Please do not schedule a client demonstration before the quality team signs off on the results. I also need each department's final equipment list by 2:00 P.M. on Wednesday so that we can verify that no devices have been left at the old location.

The Facilities team still expects to turn over the space on Friday, provided that the tests are satisfactory. If the sensor delivery is delayed beyond Wednesday, I will circulate a new schedule rather than ask the laboratory team to shorten its testing period.

DOCUMENT 2 — EAST WING RELOCATION SCHEDULE
Tuesday, October 13, 9:00 A.M. — Install network monitors; IT connectivity diagnostics may follow.
Wednesday, October 14, 1:00 P.M. — Expected delivery of replacement temperature sensor.
Wednesday, October 14, 2:00 P.M. — Department equipment lists due to Facilities.
Thursday, October 15, 10:00 A.M. — External calibration check and certificate; operational tests follow only after certification.
Friday, October 16, 2:00 P.M. — Planned handover to the laboratory, subject to quality approval.

passages.title: Workshop Travel Expenses — Policy and Help-Desk Exchange
passages.body:
DOCUMENT 1 — REVISED TRAVEL REIMBURSEMENT POLICY
Effective November 1

Employees attending an approved training event may claim reasonable travel expenses within ten business days of returning. Claims must include an itemized receipt for each meal; a credit-card transaction notice alone does not meet this requirement.

Hotel reservations should be made through the corporate booking portal. Reservations made elsewhere are eligible only when a supervisor authorized the alternative in writing before the reservation was made. The employee must attach the authorization to the claim.

Taxi fares after 9:00 P.M. may be reimbursed when no company shuttle is available. The availability of a shuttle, rather than the time alone, determines whether this exception applies.

The new policy applies to expenses incurred on or after November 1. Expenses paid before that date remain subject to the previous policy, even if the training event occurs later.

DOCUMENT 2 — HELP-DESK EXCHANGE
From: Evan Brooks, Engineering
To: Travel Support
Date: November 5
Subject: Workshop reimbursement clarification

I attended the software-security workshop on November 4. I paid for my train ticket on October 28, but my hotel was charged on November 2. The booking portal was unavailable on October 31, so my supervisor e-mailed written permission that morning for me to reserve a room directly with the hotel.

The hotel invoice is itemized. I also have a restaurant credit-card alert, although the restaurant has not provided an itemized receipt. The workshop shuttle was operating until 10:00 P.M., so I used it instead of a taxi. Which expenses can I submit under the revised policy?

From: Travel Support
Date: November 6

The hotel charge falls under the November policy. Please include the supervisor's dated authorization and the hotel invoice. The October train purchase falls under the earlier policy. For the meal, request an itemized receipt before submitting that portion of your claim. Thank you for clarifying that the shuttle was available.
